bleeding.label: Bleeding
bleeding.description: At turn start −1 Wounds per level; 10% chance per level to fall unconscious

stunned.label: Stunned
stunned.description: No action; −10 to tests per level

ablaze.label: Ablaze
ablaze.description: At turn start d10 + level − 1 damage

entangled.label: Entangled
entangled.description: Cannot move; −10 to tests per level

prone.label: Prone
prone.description: Cannot move; melee attacks against it get +20

surprised.label: Surprised
surprised.description: No action; attacks against it get +20

blinded.label: Blinded
blinded.description: −20 to own attacks; attacks against it get +20

deafened.label: Deafened
deafened.description: Cannot understand speech; an Endurance test removes it

log.fateNotFail: {name} spends Fate: I Will Not Fail
log.groupForbidden: 🚫 {name} cannot use a {group} ranged weapon without training in it
log.blackpowderPass: {name}: gunfire shock — Cool test {roll}, SL {sl}: resisted
log.blackpowderFail: {name}: gunfire shock — Cool test {roll}, SL {sl}: failed
log.unconscious: 💤 {name} drops to 0 Wounds and falls unconscious
log.fearOvercome: {name}: Fear {value} from {source} — test {roll}, SL {sl}: {total}/{value}, fear overcome
log.passionPass: {name}: {passion} ({group}) toward {source} — test {roll} / {target}, SL {sl}: kept in check
log.passionFail: {name}: {passion} ({group}) toward {source} — test {roll} / {target}, SL {sl}: failed, the urge takes over
log.frenzyFail: {name} fails to work into a Frenzy — Willpower test {roll} / {target}
log.frenzyCharge: {name} is Frenzied: must move towards and attack the nearest foe ({foe})
log.animosityVent: {name} insults and provokes {group}, the urge is spent
log.intimidateWin: {name} intimidates {target} — Intimidate {roll} / {own}, SL {sl} against Cool SL {foeSl}: Fear {rating}
log.intimidateLose: {name} fails to intimidate {target} — SL {sl} against Cool SL {foeSl}
log.frenzyStart: {name} works into a Frenzy — Willpower test {roll} / {target}
log.frenzyEnd: {name}'s Frenzy ends, the fighter is Fatigued
log.dying: ⏳ {name} is dying: {rounds} round(s) left unless healed
log.fateHowDidThatMiss: {name} spends Fate: How Did That Miss? — the attack by {attacker} has no effect
log.fateNotToday: {name} spends Fate: Not Today! — leaves the fight alive
log.outOfRange: {name}: {target} is beyond Extreme range, no shot
log.aimed: {name} takes aim at {target}: +1 SL on the next shot
log.momentumSecondAttack: {name} spends Momentum on an attack with the second weapon
log.disengageMomentum: {name} spends Momentum and moves out of melee without penalty
log.disengageFailed: {name} fails to disengage (SL {sl} against {foeSl}), the foes gain Momentum
log.runDeclared: {name} runs: the Movement of this turn doubles
log.chargeMomentum: {name} charges {target} from {yards} yards and gains Momentum; the Action must be a melee attack
log.chargeDeclared: {name} charges {target}; the Action must be a melee attack
log.fumbleDrop: {name} fumbles and drops the weapon; the next Action goes to picking it up
log.targetSurrounded: {name} is surrounded: no route of escape

fateReaction.title: Fate reaction
fateReaction.body: {attacker}'s attack hit {name}. Spend Fate to make the attack have no effect?

reason.cast: No second attack after casting a spell

attackMod.shootingIntoMelee: Target engaged in melee: Disadvantage, the GM may redirect a stray hit

head.1: The blow only rings through the skull.
head.2: A split brow floods the eyes with blood.
head.4: The helm cracks and the foe sways like a drunkard.
head.5: The skull caves in, and consciousness gutters like a candle.
head.death: The skull is crushed; death is instant.

arm.1: The arm bones ache from the strike.
arm.2: A deep cut, blood seeping through the sleeve.
arm.3: The arm is wrenched out of line: the weapon drops and the arm hangs useless for a few rounds.
arm.4: An artery is opened, blood spurts forth.
arm.5: The shoulder is thrown out of its socket: the arm is useless until it is reset.
arm.death: The limb is torn away and the victim bleeds out within moments.

body.2: Breath is knocked out, wheezing and coughing.
body.3: A ragged wound in the flank, the blood will not stop.
body.4: The blade bites deep, guts afire.
body.5: A chest blow topples the foe, darkness closing in.
body.death: A mortal wound to the vitals; death is instant.

leg.1: The knee buckles for a moment.
leg.2: A shin wound leaves a trail of blood.
leg.3: Legs swept, the foe sprawls in the mud.
leg.4: Tendon severed, the foe falls screaming.
leg.5: The knee is thrown out of joint: the foe drops and the leg is useless until it is reset.
leg.death: The limb is severed and the victim bleeds out within moments.

oops.1: Lose 1 Wound, ignoring Toughness and Armour
oops.2: The weapon takes 1 Damage; next Round you act last
oops.3: Next Round your Action has -1 SL
oops.6: A random leg is hurt for 1d10 Rounds (counts as a Critical Wound)
oops.7: You hit a random ally in range, otherwise you are Stunned

misfire.1: The weapon fails to fire; reload it
misfire.2: The weapon explodes and hurts your primary arm
